run_flask_app: run the Flask app on host 0.0.0.0 and port 80 as a development server
create_flask_app: create a Flask application instance with the default configuration
define_route_hello: define a route handler for the root path that returns a Hello World response
test_flask_route: test the Flask app root route returns the expected Hello World HTML response
review_flask_app: review the Flask app configuration and route setup for production readiness
